fields.description: Save slot display name, NUL-terminated ASCII. Zero-filled (0x19 bytes) by FUN_08062b88 then strcpy'd via FUN_08062c40 on save (FUN_08062488) and on first boot (FUN_08062520, from the scenario/name table indexed by game-state byte +0x13e). Baseline holds default "Empty slot".
fields.evidence: FUN_08062488 zeroes 0x19 bytes via FUN_08062b88 then FUN_08062c40 strcpy into save offset 0x00; FUN_08062520 builds the same buffer and copies the scenario name table entry; FUN_0806240c loads these bytes from EEPROM chunks 0-3 via FUN_080a53a8.
fields.name: slot_name

fields.description: Per-slot option/status byte mirrored between the save and the live game-state struct byte (default 0x7f written when no valid save exists). Written on save, restored into game state on valid load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08062488 stores the live game-state byte to save offset 0x19; FUN_08062520 writes default 0x7f to the game-state byte and restores it from save offset 0x19 on valid load; baseline logical byte is 0x7f.
fields.name: slot_option

fields.description: 4-byte save validation magic FE ED FA CE. FUN_080625d0 memcmp's save bytes 0x1A-0x1D against the ROM constant; a mismatch forces the default (wipe + rewrite) path in FUN_08062520.
fields.evidence: FUN_080625d0 compares 4 bytes at save offset 0x1a against the ROM constant and gates FUN_08062520 load-vs-default; FUN_08062488 stores these 4 bytes from the ROM table at save offsets 0x1a-0x1d; baseline logical bytes are FE ED FA CE.
fields.name: save_magic_tag

fields.description: Low byte of the persisted u16 mirrored with game-state halfword +0x13c (default 0). Stored as two separate byte stores on save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08062488 writes save offset 0x1e from game-state u16 +0x13c low byte; FUN_08062520 defaults game-state +0x13c to 0 and restores it from save offset 0x1e on valid load; baseline is 0x00.
fields.name: slot_value_lo

fields.description: High byte of the persisted u16 mirrored with game-state halfword +0x13c (default 0). Stored as two separate byte stores on save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08062488 writes save offset 0x1f from game-state u16 +0x13c high byte; FUN_08062520 restores game-state +0x13c from save offsets 0x1e-0x1f as a halfword on valid load; baseline is 0x00.
fields.name: slot_value_hi

magic_signatures.description: Save validation magic FE ED FA CE checked by FUN_080625d0 at logical save offsets 0x1A-0x1D.
